scope.summary: Implement genital modular export attachments (spec 13.21/13.26 boundary; GREQ-033): an export option splitting genital regions into a separate mesh with own bones and material plus body-seam weld data so game lanes can attach/detach anatomy SOS-style, with a weld round-trip proven equal to the pre-welded single-mesh path and clean censor-toggle composition.
acceptance_criteria: Modular export option: genital regions split into a separate mesh with own material and genital bones, plus body-seam weld data (vertex-pair map) so engines can reattach and weld - the SOS modular pattern, native (GREQ-033).
Weld round-trip: exported split plus weld map re-merges to a watertight mesh MeshComparator-equal to the pre-welded single-mesh export path.
Censor-toggle composition: an SFW body export excludes the genital attachment cleanly with no dangling weld references.
Manifest rows record attachment metadata for BkExport validation (MT-622 lineage).
scope.risk_if_missed: Game pipelines need genitals as optional modular attachments (the SOS retrofit proves the demand); without a proven weld round-trip, studios must choose between always-fused NSFW bodies or visibly broken seams (GREQ-033).

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend/solver scope: behavior is observable via TraceProjection, typed TAILOR_BODY_* receipts, and the 13.12 capture APIs; operator/model GUI exposure rides the BodyKit panes (13.27) and is validated there.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Emits/extends the TAILOR_BODY_* KernelEventType family on the EventLedger per Section 13.16 (extends the 13.14 canonical list).
internal_diagnostics ships with WP-KERNEL-012; wire the open diagnostic-event API for this behavior in the WP-KERNEL-016 retrofit.
Palmistry external watcher ships with WP-KERNEL-012/016; long generation/bake/export runs get child-stall watch coverage in the retrofit.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.
